sign_off.notes: Not a clean pass: I filed 2 bug reports and the sweep found defects in two of the four areas. Filed: (1) Number bases: every base result is multiplied by 10 (15 dec in hex shows 0x96, 10 dec in bin 0b1100100, 64 dec in oct 0o1200, 255 dec in hex 0x9F6). (2) Date gaps: the day count is not reduced when the end time-of-day is earlier than the start time-of-day (1981 case shows 19 d, should be 18 d; 2020 case shows 15 d, should be 14 d). A second report on the 2020 case was rejected as a duplicate of the same root cause. Checked and OK: Expenses and Monthly budget totals/avg; Temperatures (-10 C = 14 F, -40 F = -40 C, -65 F = -53.89 C); Temperature sums; kelvin conversions in the scratchpad (0 C to K, 273.15 K to C, 100 F to K = 310.93 K); Time differences (incl. negative spans); Remainders; Percentages; Date gaps for date() and 1-month cases; home list (all 9 files, order, dates) after rotation and relaunch; search with 1 match and 2 matches. Not covered: the Sort menu, Settings, editing and saving files, and undo/redo inside a file. My typing in the scratchpad produced a few merged lines, which I took to be my own input error, not an app bug.
